title: 2 hr Lake Austin Boat Cruise. BYOB (Private - up to 12 guests)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Meet the captain under the 360 Bridge, Guide will look for Lead Travelers at 5019 North Texas Capitol Highway.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Set out on a one-of-a-kind journey across the pristine waters of Lake Austin 

where natural beauty meets luxury living. Glide through the heart of the Texas Hill Country, catch an early morning beautiful sunrise, a mid day sun trip (bimini top for shade), a scenic sunset or after hours night booze cruise to Ski Shores Cafe for a cocktail. 

All while being surrounded by lush greenery, rolling landscapes, lime stone cliffs, multimillion dollar estates and see where the "Movie Stars" live. 

Cruise through the iconic “Little Italy” neighborhood with charm as you pass elegant waterfront estates that feel straight out of the Mediterranean. 

It’s not just a boat ride — it’s an unforgettable Austin experience!

(Pickup/drop off address: 5019 N capital of Texas Highway.)

What's excluded:

X $5 (Cash Only) per person to park and enter park booth at boat ramp. 

X 20% Captain Gratuity - not included. pay in person to your professional Captain at the end of your tour (cash, venmo or zelle)
